The community gamepad mapping database shipped as `resources/gamecontrollerdb.txt`.

Source: https://github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB (zlib license, see LICENSE)

This directory exists so the packager's license sweep (scripts/package.py
collect_licenses) picks up the attribution; the data file itself lives in
resources/ so it is installed next to the binaries and can be updated by users.
